install.agentRequest: 请先在 deeplugin.store 中检索 Registry ID deeplugin-2afeb5ddb5cc2c0eb69f，展示来源和精确安装 spec，为 web profile 生成安装计划；等我明确批准后再安装。

posts.zh:
dsh-pathlink 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在对话中 Ctrl+点击文件路径与链接：路径在文件管理器中定位所在文件夹，链接在新标签页打开。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-2afeb5ddb5cc2c0eb69f.html
posts.en:
dsh-pathlink is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Ctrl+click file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager (with the file selected), links open in a new browser tab.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-2afeb5ddb5cc2c0eb69f.html
